summary: Iteration 11 testing of the PART PRODUCTION F1 revision, backend and frontend. Backend: new test_iter11_period_generate_bulk.py has 25 tests and all pass. I updated the iter8/9/10 regression tests to the new rules (ACT STOCK = SHIFT 2 of D-1, row id 'date|ics|type'). All 107 tests in iter8-11 pass with -n 0. Frontend: everything tested on Kebutuhan and Stock Part Production works with Playwright: freeze panes, virtualization, keyboard edit of far rows (row 300 on Kebutuhan, row 900 on Stock), period/group filters, RESET FILTER, checklist delete (cancel and confirm), the Generate Harian dialog, and read-only mode for assy. One functional bug found: saving a stock row through the add/edit form with blank group inputs stores 0 instead of null. That makes ACT STOCK 0 and STATUS PART a false SHORTAGE.

minor.issue: normalize() turns blank group1..group6/part_ragu into num(None)=0.0, so compute_smt_stock never sees all inputs as None and total becomes 0.0 instead of null. Reproduced: PUT on a generated empty SHIFT 2 row of 2033-01-20 with only date/shift/lane/product/type/ics_no gave total 0.0. Kebutuhan 2033-01-21 then showed act_stock 0 and status_part SHORTAGE (should be null and '-'). POST with blank inputs also gives total 0.0. Only inline cell PATCH keeps null correctly.
id is f"{r['date']}|{r['id']}" but needs_row id now already starts with the date, giving 'date|date|ics|type'. Only cosmetic (React key), but it should use r['id'].
Still calls the helper with the old name shift3_stock_map, which now returns SHIFT 2 of D-1. The logic is correct; only the name is misleading.

issues: The STATUS PART column is too narrow, so the badge is cut to 'BELUM TERSE...'.
Date filters use the browser's native <input type=date> instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover picker. This was the existing pattern.
The default date in the add form uses the browser's local timezone (today()), not WIB like the filters (todayWib).

action_items: In normalize() for smt_stock, keep blank STOCK_INPUTS as None (not 0) so form create/edit of an empty row keeps total=null and act_stock '-'. Or make compute_smt_stock look at the raw body.
Fix the dashboard top_shortage id so it is not 'date|date|ics|type' (use r['id']).
Optional: widen the STATUS PART column in the Stock grid, use todayWib for the form's default date, and rename shift3_stock_map.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is about 2060 lines, which is too big; split it into routers (needs, stock, generate/cron, dashboard).
needs_grid_clear runs find_one_and_delete plus an audit insert once per row (up to 50000 rows). Very large selections will be slow; use a delete_many plus a bulk audit insert.
smt_stock_bulk_delete silently skips invalid ObjectIds (selected vs deleted counts are returned, which is fine).
Cron: run_id defaults to 'manual-<timestamp>' when there is no X-Webhook-Id, so every call without that header triggers a new run. That is acceptable because generation is idempotent.
Old tests test_iter6_prod_stock_backup.py etc. are outdated (KeyError 'total_act_smt', from previous refactors). They were not part of this scope; I did not run them further.

rca of the issue: Blank stock form values become 0: normalize() in server.py loops over FIELDS and, for numeric fields, calls num(v), which returns 0.0 for None or ''. compute_smt_stock then sees 0.0 values instead of None, so it returns total 0 and status KOSONG. Repro: PUT /api/smt-stock/{generated_row_id} with only the identity fields, or POST with blank groups, gives total 0.0. GET /api/needs-grid for D+1 then shows act_stock 0 and status_part SHORTAGE. Mitigation: in normalize, for module smt_stock, map blank or missing STOCK_INPUTS to None before calling compute.
